description.message: Color picker and eyedropper: get the HEX, RGB, HSL or CSS filter code of any color on screen, see its name, save color palettes.

eyedropper.description: Screen reader name of the round button that starts the eyedropper, which picks a color from anywhere on the screen. Not shown on screen.

copyColorName.description: Screen reader name of the button that shows the selected color's name; pressing it copies the name. Keep $COLOR_NAME$ where the name is read. Not shown on screen.

settings.description: Heading of the Settings page, and the screen reader name of the gear button that opens it.

saveColor.description: Screen reader name of the + button that saves the selected color to the palette. Not shown on screen.

selectedColor.description: Screen reader name of the color field that opens the system's color picker for the selected color. Not shown on screen.

filterFormat.description: Text of the last of five tabs (HEX, RGB, HSL, HSV, Filter); it shows the color as a CSS filter. The tab is about 50 pixels wide, so one short word. Keep Filter if your language uses the CSS term as is.

copyColorCode.description: Screen reader name of the button that copies the color's code in the selected format. Not shown on screen.

moveColors.description: Screen reader name of the toolbar button that lets you drag saved colors to reorder them. Not shown on screen.

tintsAndShades.description: Screen reader name of the toolbar button that shows lighter (tints) and darker (shades) versions of a color. Not shown on screen.

deleteColors.description: Screen reader name of the toolbar button that lets you delete saved colors one at a time. Not shown on screen.

deleteAllColors.description: Screen reader name of the toolbar button that deletes every saved color. Not shown on screen.

downloadPng.description: Screen reader name of the toolbar button that downloads the palette as a PNG image. Keep PNG. Not shown on screen.

downloadCsv.description: Screen reader name of the toolbar button that downloads the palette as a CSV file. Keep CSV. Not shown on screen.

colorsPerLine.description: Screen reader name of the menu that sets how many colors each row of the palette shows, from 5 to 10. Not shown on screen.

deleteAllConfirmation.description: Question in the browser's confirmation dialog before every saved color is deleted.

back.description: Screen reader name of the arrow button that goes back from Settings to the color picker. Not shown on screen.

theme.description: Settings label next to the switch between the light and the dark theme.

darkTheme.description: Screen reader name of the theme switch, which is on while the dark theme is used. Not shown on screen.

autoSaveEyedropper.description: Settings label of a switch: when on, a color picked with the eyedropper is saved to the palette right away.

autoCopyCode.description: Settings label of a switch: when on, a color's code is copied to the clipboard when the color is saved or clicked in the palette.

addHashToHex.description: Settings label of a switch: when on, HEX codes start with #, as in #FF6600. Keep # and HEX.

showColorName.description: Settings label of a switch: when on, the selected color's name shows at the top of the popup and in the PNG download.

prependBlackToFilter.description: Settings label of a switch: when on, the CSS filter code starts with brightness(0) saturate(100%), which first turns the element black so the filter gives the same color on any element.

website.description: Label of the button in Settings that opens ColorPal's website.

languageCode.description: This file's language code, such as en, de or pt-BR. Not translated.
